page_title: PAL 1-2 BAR | Las Palmas v Barcelona 04/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

90+7' What a miss! Vitor Roque (Barcelona) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
90+6' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+3' 1 - 2 Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Alvaro Valles to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
90+3' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+2' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) attempts to discuss the decision with Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90+2' Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes stops the game and makes a call. The referee gives a penalty to Barcelona!
90+1' Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
89' The main referee, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card for dissent.
88' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is flagged for offside.
86' The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
86' Joao Felix (Barcelona) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
84' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Substitution. Alex Suarez walks off the pitch and Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
82' Joao Felix (Barcelona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
81' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
80' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
79' What was Saul Coco (Las Palmas) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
78' Xavi has decided to substitute Sergi Roberto and he is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
78' That's the end of the game for Ferran Torres, who is replaced by Vitor Roque (Barcelona).
78' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
77' The corner is swung in and Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the left post from close in.
76' The referee awards a corner and Pejino (Las Palmas) goes over to take it.
76' Pejino (Las Palmas) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

74' Pejino (Las Palmas) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
74' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) sends a long cross over to Lamine Yamal, but Alvaro Valles comes forward to gather the ball.
72' Xavi prepares a substitution. Robert Lewandowski is replaced by Joao Felix (Barcelona).
72' Here comes a substitution. Raphinha is given a rest as he is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Barcelona comes to nothing.
70' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
69' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
68' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Pejino (Las Palmas) replaces Sandro Ramirez.
68' A substitution has been made. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
67' The ball is cleared after Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
65' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
64' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
62' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
61' Great touch by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
59' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Munir El Haddadi.
58' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
55' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
54' Raphinha (Barcelona) is caught offside!
53' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
51' Raphinha (Barcelona) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
50' A pass by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
48' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take the corner.
48' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
44' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
43' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
43' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
42' A pass by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
42' Raphinha (Barcelona) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
41' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
40' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
40' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
35' Flag goes up against Raphinha (Barcelona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
32' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
32' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
31' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
29' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
28' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Inaki Pena is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
25' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
23' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
20' Xavi (Barcelona) gets a yellow card, off the field.
20' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) is booked for saying more than Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes was willing to tolerate.
16' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
16' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
15' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
15' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' 1 - 0 Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
11' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joao Cancelo will be replaced by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).
10' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
8' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
6' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
5' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
4' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
2' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
